text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Breaking away out in front is Eishin Flash!
Unbelievable, it's Eishin Flash—!!
(Uwooooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
The Derby Umamusume is Eishin Flash!?
Amazing, congratulations~~~!!
Flash-sama~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see.
I actually won, didn't I...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A Derby Umamusume.
I will—

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Super, toll, klasse, Flash!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Mom, I... did something amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (I won the Derby...!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I can win on such a grand stage again...
I hope the two of them will be there with me—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I still haven't come down from the excitement...
I'll calm down shortly.
choice_data_list: Why not bask in the afterglow a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, the race is already over.
The schedule is complete.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In that case... I must think about what comes next.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Failing to control one's emotions
is not the proper way to conduct oneself.
choice_data_list: Of course it feels great to win.
Of course it feels great to win, you know.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...However, greed starts to creep in.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
If we let this linger any longer—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I want to win. I find myself feeling that...
nothing less than that will ever satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you think so?
Even just placing is undoubtedly a wonderful result."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's why placing on the board was my goal.
However, now...
choice_data_list: Let's win the next one too, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
let's move on to our next topic right away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Heading into the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown races—the Kikuka-sho.
choice_data_list: Shall we head back to the waiting room then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes—!

When I returned to the waiting room, there was a message
waiting from Eishin Flash's parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on 1st place! Over here,
even though it's morning, regulars and neighbors
have come over to celebrate!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'm so grateful.
"Truthfully, I just want to hold you tight and cheer you on."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Getting 1st place is truly wonderful.
It's proof that you put in the hard work and grew stronger."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "May the joy of magnificent victories continue to fill your heart."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...My parents have no plans
to visit Japan during these three years.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I want to bring you lots of victory reports, at the very least.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We've achieved the expected results up to this point.
Let's continue on track just like this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Before that, there's one thing I'd like to mention.
I don't think it's a big deal, but actually—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I still cannot accept this.
—Why are you taking the Kikuka Sho off our goals?
After the race, I had a doctor examine Eishin Flash following her report of discomfort in her legs... It seemed to be accumulated muscular fatigue.
choice_data_list: If you don't rest, the pain will only get worse.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it is entirely possible
to make a full recovery by the Kikuka Sho."
choice_data_list: Of course, if you feel up to it, let's enter.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I don't understand that.
You set a goal, and plan your schedule toward it.
Shouldn't that be more than enough to handle it?
choice_data_list: Can you promise you won't push yourself too hard?

text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is such a punishing race that they say only the strongest Umamusume can win it, requiring immense innate stamina.
With our current schedule, fatigue will only continue to build.
choice_data_list: Your goal was to "run your race to the end," right?
Your goal was to "run your race to the end," wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...
However—
"Adjusting the schedule depending on my judgment."
"Adjust the schedule depending on my judgment."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
............
A promise is a promise, no matter what...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I will remove... the Kikuka Sho from my goals.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Running the race through to the end is what's most important, after all...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...... I'm fine.
Excuse me, I'll be going now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My perfect schedule is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: After consulting with my father and mother—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way I could say it.
The breakdown was caused by my poor management...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because it's all due to my own shortcomings—
